$comment: Version/source matrix for third-party libraries under compile/lib*. Extracted from the Dockerfiles on 2026-09-11 (see CLAUDE.md, decision 11). 'latest' in config.yaml resolves to the last entry of 'versions'. GitHub-hosted libraries (sourceType github-release/github-tag) are auto-refreshed via `node compile/cli.mjs update-versions` (compile/update-lib-versions.mjs); everything else (tarball/sourceforge/googlesource sources) still has to be checked manually via its own checkUrl.

libcurl.note: GitHub release tags use underscores (e.g. curl-8_22_0) rather than dots; update-lib-versions.mjs normalizes them to dots before recording here. TESTED and ADOPTED 2026-09-12: 8.22.0 builds cleanly once `--without-libpsl` is added to compile/libcurl/Dockerfile's configure flags — curl 8.x added a hard `libpsl` (Public Suffix List, cookie-domain-matching) dependency we don't vendor; disabling that optional feature is enough (HTTP2/nghttp2 support confirmed still enabled in the build log). compile/Makefile's CURL_VERSION now reads this array's last entry directly (see CLAUDE.md decision 27) rather than being hand-synced.

libzip.note: Two versions are built in parallel by the Makefile (1.2.0 and 1.9.2), not a single 'latest'.

libopenssl.note: Upstream Playground pinned two versions built in parallel (1.1.0h/1.1.1t) for broader PHP-version support; we only target PHP 8.5 (see CLAUDE.md decision 16) so compile/Makefile now builds a single version. Verified 2026-09-12 that 3.6.4 (latest stable 3.x; 4.0.x exists but is very new) cross-compiles with the existing Dockerfile unmodified.

libImageMagick.note: Default policy (2026-09-12): always try the latest version first, only fall back to an older pin if it actually fails a real test build. TESTED and ADOPTED 2026-09-12: 7.1.2-31 rebuilds cleanly against the fresh libpng16/libjpeg/libwebp below.

libjpeg.note: Default policy (2026-09-12): always try the latest version first. update-lib-versions.mjs's github-tag fallback is noisy for this repo (its tags mix in historical IJG libjpeg versions like 'jpeg-9') — 3.2.0 confirmed as latest via the GitHub Releases page directly. TESTED and REVERTED 2026-09-12: 3.2.0 fails a real build — it added a bundled `src/spng/` (PNG) module that uses raw x86 SSE2 intrinsics (`__m128i`, `_mm_cvtsi128_si32`) unconditionally reachable under our `-D__x86_64__` compile flag, which don't exist under Emscripten without `-msimd128`. Stayed on 3.0.3. Would need a real patch (disable spng, or add SIMD polyfill flags) to move forward — not attempted. IMPORTANT: 3.2.0 is deliberately NOT last in `versions` (out of chronological order) — since decision 28 wired compile/Makefile's LIBJPEG_VERSION to `MATRIX_VERSION` (the array's last entry), putting the known-broken version last would make the very next `make libjpeg_jspi` try to build it. Re-checked 2026-09-16 via `update-lib-versions.mjs`: GitHub's real latest release is still 3.2.0 (no newer fix upstream) — the script itself used to report this as a misleading `3.0.3 → 3.2.0` "update" every time, since it only compared against the array's *last* entry rather than checking whether the version was already recorded elsewhere; fixed the script to recognize 3.2.0 is already present and stay silent instead.

libavif.note: Default policy (2026-09-12): always try the latest version first. TESTED and ADOPTED 2026-09-12: v1.4.2 rebuilds cleanly.

libpng16.note: Default policy (2026-09-12): always try the latest STABLE version first (github.com/pnggroup/libpng's newest tags are 1.7.0 betas — not stable; 1.6.58 is the latest stable 1.6.x). TESTED and ADOPTED 2026-09-12: 1.6.58 rebuilds cleanly.

libxml2.note: Default policy (2026-09-12): always try the latest version first. TESTED and ADOPTED 2026-09-12: v2.15.4 rebuilds cleanly.

libwebp.note: Default policy (2026-09-12): always try the latest version first. TESTED and ADOPTED 2026-09-12: moved off the commit pin to the v1.6.0 tag, rebuilds cleanly (libsharpyuv.a still produced alongside libwebp.a).

oniguruma.note: NO pinned version in the current Dockerfile: clones the default branch on every build. Reproducibility not guaranteed. Fix by pinning a tag here.

libssh2.$comment: For curl SFTP/SCP support (CLAUDE.md decision 24). Real GitHub org/repo verified via `gh api`, not guessed from memory.

nghttp2.$comment: For curl HTTP/2 support (CLAUDE.md decision 25). Built with --enable-lib-only to skip the CLI apps/examples, which pull in unrelated deps (libcurl, libev, jansson, boost...).

freetype.$comment: GD's FreeType dependency for text rendering (imagettftext/gdImageStringFT). Moved here from plannedLibraries 2026-09-12 once compile/libfreetype/Dockerfile was written and wired into compile/libgd/Dockerfile + compile/php/Dockerfile's WITH_GD block. Tag format is VER-<version with dots replaced by dashes>, e.g. 2.14.3 -> VER-2-14-3; the Dockerfile does that substitution itself.
freetype.note: Bug found and fixed 2026-09-16: update-lib-versions.mjs's github-tag lookup only ever matched plain dotted version tags, so it couldn't resolve anything here at all ("could not resolve a version") — freetype's own VER-2-14-3 dashed tag convention never matched. Fixed the script to convert VER-<N>-<N>-<N> tags to dotted form before filtering/comparing, same as it already did for ImageMagick's own non-standard tag suffix. Re-checked afterward: 2.14.3 is confirmed still latest upstream.

libsodium.$comment: For ext/sodium (CLAUDE.md decision 32 — the mode:shared pilot). Moved here from plannedLibraries 2026-09-12 once compile/libsodium/Dockerfile was written. No dependency on libz/libopenssl — self-contained crypto.

libyaml.$comment: For ext/yaml (CLAUDE.md decision 34, static build). Moved here from plannedLibraries 2026-09-12 once compile/libyaml/Dockerfile was written. Latest tag (0.2.6-rc.1) is a release candidate — pinned to the latest STABLE release instead, same policy as libpng16.

libcmark-gfm.$comment: GitHub's own CommonMark+GFM C library (github/cmark-gfm), for the new ext/mdhtml (CLAUDE.md decision 37, static build) -- the Kirigami markdown extension that replaces ext/cmark, which was tried both statically (decision 35) and as a mode:shared package (decision 38) before being dropped entirely (decision 40). Builds two static archives from one source tree, libcmark-gfm.a (core) and libcmark-gfm-extensions.a (table/strikethrough/autolink/tagfilter/tasklist), see compile/libcmark-gfm/Dockerfile.
libcmark-gfm.note: Real bug found and fixed 2026-09-16, before it could cause damage: update-lib-versions.mjs's normalizeVersion() stripped a tag at its first non-numeric segment, so cmark-gfm's own '0.29.0.gfm.13' tag was silently truncated to '0.29.0' -- not a real, independent cmark-gfm release, just the mangled remainder of the actual one. Writing that would have regressed compile/libcmark-gfm/Dockerfile's resolved version. Fixed the regex to also capture a trailing '.gfm.N' suffix. Re-checked afterward: 0.29.0.gfm.13 is confirmed still latest upstream.

simdjson.$comment: For ext/jsonk (CLAUDE.md's jsonk decision) -- decode engine. Not built via a compile/lib*/Dockerfile+Makefile target like every other entry here: it ships as a single-header amalgamation (simdjson.h + simdjson.cpp) fetched as GitHub release assets straight into ext/jsonk/vendor/simdjson/ by compile/php/Dockerfile itself (no build step of its own), same layout php-jsonk's own vendor/build/stage.sh uses for a native dev build. Listed here anyway so getMatrixVersion() has one place to resolve it from, matching matrix.json's own "latest = last versions[] entry" convention.

yyjson.$comment: For ext/jsonk (CLAUDE.md's jsonk decision) -- encode engine + schema-document reader. Same "vendored flat file, no Dockerfile/Makefile target" shape as simdjson above (yyjson.h + yyjson.c fetched directly from the tagged ref into ext/jsonk/vendor/yyjson/).

utf8proc.$comment: For ext/norm (php-kirigami/php-norm) -- Unicode NFC/NFD/NFKC/NFKD normalization via utf8proc_map(). Same "vendored flat files, no compile/lib*/Dockerfile+Makefile target" shape as simdjson/yyjson above: utf8proc.h/utf8proc.c/utf8proc_data.c are already flat files at the JuliaStrings/utf8proc repo root (utf8proc_data.c is a pre-generated Unicode data table, committed by the maintainers, #include'd by utf8proc.c itself -- never compiled as its own translation unit), fetched directly from the tagged ref straight into ext/norm/vendor/utf8proc/ by compile/php/Dockerfile, same layout php-norm's own vendor/build/stage.sh uses for a native dev build.

extensions.$comment: Ported from php-static-autobuilder's own matrix.json (https://github.com/ZmotriN/php-static-autobuilder), 2026-09-12, per CLAUDE.md decisions 24/28. Fields: builtin (part of php-src vs. a separate repo), mandatory, switch (the ./configure flag), dependencies (other extensions it needs), libraries (third-party libs it needs — the per-extension dependency list requested by the user, matching LIB_TARGETS_BY_EXTENSION in compile/cli.mjs conceptually, though the two aren't wired together yet and use different library-name spellings: this section keeps php-static-autobuilder's own names verbatim, e.g. 'zlib'/'libpng'/'openssl', not this repo's 'libz'/'libpng16'/'libopenssl'). Windows-only extensions (win32std, winbinder, wcli, win32ps, win32service, com_dotnet) were dropped entirely, not carried over — they don't apply to a WASM/Node target. Data only: none of this is wired into compile/php/Dockerfile or cli.mjs's IMPLEMENTED_EXTENSIONS yet, most of these 103 extensions aren't buildable here at all today (see config.yaml's long 'off' list and CLAUDE.md's Context section for what's actually wired).

posix.note: Added 2026-09-16 (CLAUDE.md decision 48's batch) -- missing from this matrix entirely before then, same reason as sysvmsg/sysvsem: php-static-autobuilder's own matrix.json is Windows-only and never lists this POSIX-only extension, so it never got ported. Wired as mode: shared; compile-extension build succeeded on the first try, no known runtime risk (most posix_* functions map to real, Emscripten-implemented libc calls).

pcntl.note: Tried 2026-09-16 (CLAUDE.md decision 48's batch), deliberately abandoned -- not just left mode: off, removed from config.yaml and compile/extensions/ entirely (same treatment as ext/cmark, decision 40). Hit a real cross-compile false positive first (HAVE_GETCPUID wrongly detected, pulling in Solaris's <sys/processor.h> -- fixed with a direct edit to the vendored pcntl.c, `&& !defined(__EMSCRIPTEN__)` on that one guard), then a second build failure not worth chasing. More fundamentally: its entire feature set (fork(), waitpid(), inter-process signals) has no real equivalent in a single-instance WASM VM with no real OS process model -- even a successful build would ship functions that silently do nothing useful or fail unpredictably, unlike shmop/sysvshm/sysvmsg/sysvsem which at least have a plausible path to real behavior. `disabled: true` marks this as "tried and rejected", not "not yet attempted" -- don't re-attempt without a real reason to revisit that conclusion.

readline.note: Pas sur que ça fonctionne avec la vm de PHP-wasm

shmop.note: Tried 2026-09-16 (CLAUDE.md decision 48's batch), deliberately abandoned -- removed from config.yaml and compile/extensions/ entirely, same treatment as pcntl. compile-extension itself built the .so fine, but shmget/shmat/shmctl/shmdt (declared but not implemented by Emscripten's libc, decision 43) confirmed to not even exist as exportable symbols for the main php.wasm to expose -- every shmop_* function would be permanently broken. `disabled: true` marks this as "tried and rejected"; don't re-attempt without a real reason to revisit (e.g. a patched Emscripten libc).

sysvmsg.note: Added and tried 2026-09-16 (CLAUDE.md decision 48's batch), deliberately abandoned -- missing from this matrix entirely before then (ported originally from php-static-autobuilder's own matrix.json, which is Windows-only and never lists this POSIX-only extension). msgget/msgsnd/msgrcv/msgctl confirmed to not exist as exportable symbols under Emscripten -- removed from config.yaml/compile/extensions/ entirely, same treatment as shmop. `disabled: true` marks this as "tried and rejected".

yaml.$comment: Sourced from the extension's own GitHub repo/tags, not pecl.php.net's package archive — PECL's own listing lags behind (CLAUDE.md decision 34: 'often bien plus a jour' on GitHub).

apcu.note: On va probablement la mettre dans le core si la mémoire persiste dans la vm de php-wasm -- being tried now: added to config.yaml as mode: static (CLAUDE.md's jsonk/apcu decision). Verified 2026-09-16 against apcu's real config.m4: igbinary (removed from "dependencies" above, that field doesn't exist on this entry anymore) is only an optional faster serializer it detects at runtime, not a hard PHP_ADD_EXTENSION_DEP -- the field carried over from php-static-autobuilder's matrix.json was wrong. Its rwlock/mutex pthread capability probes use AC_RUN_IFELSE but already supply a real cross-compiling action (assume yes, same as native) -- unlike ext/cmark's AC_TRY_RUN (CLAUDE.md decision 34), no patch needed there. Not yet build-tested: whether Emscripten's non-`-pthread` build actually resolves the pthread_mutex*/pthread_rwlock* symbols APCu's own "yes" assumption links against is unconfirmed.

imagick.note: Not present in php-static-autobuilder's own matrix (Windows php builder never added it) — added 2026-09-12 since this repo does support it (compile/php/Dockerfile WITH_IMAGICK block). Was tracking the unpinned 'master' branch directly (compile/php/Dockerfile's own IMAGICK_BRANCH="master" for PHP 8.x) until a real, user-noticed bug: php_imagick.h ships `#define PHP_IMAGICK_VERSION "@PACKAGE_VERSION@"` literally (its own comment: "deliberately left as PACKAGE_VERSION in source code") — a placeholder only ever substituted by PECL's own packaging tool (`pecl package`, reading package.xml) at release-tarball-build time, which this pipeline's plain `git clone`/tag-tarball fetch never runs, so phpinfo() displayed the raw, unsubstituted string. Fixed 2026-09-16 by pinning to the real latest tag (3.8.1) instead of floating on master (also makes the build reproducible, closing the same class of gap decision 11 already flagged for oniguruma) and sed-replacing @PACKAGE_VERSION@ with that same pinned version in compile/php/Dockerfile right after fetching.

mdhtml.$comment: php-kirigami/php-mdhtml -- our own CommonMark+GFM extension (cmark-gfm-based), replacing ext/cmark as the core, static-mode markdown renderer (CLAUDE.md decision 37; see extensions.cmark's own 'ABANDONED' note). config.m4 uses PHP_ARG_WITH (--with-mdhtml[=DIR]), same shape as ext/cmark's own --with-cmark.

jsonk.$comment: php-kirigami/php-jsonk (the user's own project) -- fast JSON encode/decode + JSON Schema validation, built on vendored simdjson (decode)+yyjson (encode/schema-doc reads), see matrix.json's own "simdjson"/"yyjson" entries above. Has a HARD zend_module_dep on "json" and "pcre" -- it can't load without ext/json already loaded, so this build doesn't (and can't) disable ext/json: php-src's own ext/json/config.m4 takes no PHP_ARG_ENABLE at all in PHP 8.5, there is no --disable-json flag to begin with. "Replacing json" (as requested) is done by flipping jsonk's own "jsonk.replace_json_functions" ini default from its upstream "0" to "1" for this build (a one-line sed via /root/replace.sh in compile/php/Dockerfile, not a patches/jsonk/*.patch file -- too small a literal-string change to warrant one). Not yet build-tested: the first C++ extension in this pipeline (config.m4's PHP_REQUIRE_CXX/-std=c++17), though JSPI mode's existing -fwasm-exceptions flag (decision 6) means real C++ exceptions are already supported if simdjson's amalgamation ever needs them (jsonk_decode.cpp itself only uses simdjson's non-throwing .get() API).

navicat.$comment: php-kirigami/php-navicat (the user's own project) -- native client for Navicat Premium's HTTP-tunnel protocol (ntunnel_mysql.php), reverse-engineered from Navicat's own server scripts. config.m4 uses PHP_ARG_WITH (--with-navicat[=DIR]), reusing the libcurl already linked in via the WITH_CURL block for the static build -- no separate .emcc-php-wasm-sources entry needed, libcurl.a is already appended there.

igbinary.$comment: igbinary/igbinary -- faster binary serializer, no external lib. Its own config.m4 auto-detects apcu (checks for ext/apcu/apc_serializer.h at configure time) and registers itself as an APCu serializer when found -- this build also flips apcu's own "apc.serializer" ini default from "php" to "igbinary" (CLAUDE.md decision 45's follow-up, only when WITH_IGBINARY=yes).

norm.$comment: php-kirigami/php-norm (the user's own project) -- native Normalizer class + normalizer_normalize()/normalizer_is_normalized() functions, wrapping vendored utf8proc (see matrix.json's own "utf8proc" library entry above), same 'vendored flat source files, no compile/lib*/Dockerfile' shape as ext/jsonk's simdjson/yyjson (utf8proc.c is compiled directly into ext/norm's own object files -- no separate .a, no .emcc-php-wasm-sources entry needed). Only registers its Normalizer class/normalizer_*() functions if intl (or anything else) hasn't already provided them (zend_hash_str_exists guards in PHP_MINIT_FUNCTION(norm), ZEND_MOD_OPTIONAL("intl") purely for MINIT ordering) -- safe to always build in as mode: static regardless of intl's own state.

plannedLibraries.$comment: Requested 2026-09-12: build out Dockerfiles for (ideally) every library + extension php-static-autobuilder's own matrix.json covers (CLAUDE.md decision 24). This section records real, gh-api-verified upstream sources + currently-latest versions for the ones not yet wired into a compile/<lib>/Dockerfile — data-entry done, Dockerfiles not written/tested yet. Excludes Windows-only libraries from php-static-autobuilder's list that don't apply to a WASM/Linux cross-compile (pthread-win32, wineditline, dirent, fbclient's nocrt Windows build). A few repos could not be auto-verified (no matching release/tag found via the GitHub API in one pass) and are marked 'checkUrl: manual' instead of a repo — needs a human/deeper look, not a confirmed gap.

zlib.note: We already vendor zlib as 'libz' (zlib.net tarball, tested/working) — this is just recording the alternate GitHub-mirror source php-static-autobuilder uses, not a second copy to build.

openldap.note: For ext/ldap. GitHub mirror (openldap/openldap) has no releases and non-numeric tags (development branch names) — check openldap.org directly.
